name: ECON 3313
title: Elementary Economic Forecasting
description: Economic forecasting for macroeconomics and financial economics. Econometric analysis of time-series data.
requirement_description: ECON 2202 or 2212Q; STAT 1000Q or 1100Q; (i) ECON 2311Q and ECON 2312Q, or (ii) STAT 3215Q and STAT 3025Q or STAT 3375Q or MATH 3160; open to juniors or higher.
